question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Hypocrisy
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Hypocrisy"** means the practice of claiming to have moral standards or beliefs to which one's own behavior does not conform; pretense. (पाखंड)

 
 
• **Example: **His **hypocrisy** was evident when he criticized others for cheating while he himself was dishonest.
 
 
 
• **"Deceit" **refers to the action or practice of deceiving someone by concealing or misrepresenting the truth. (धोखा)
 
 
• **Example: **She was accused of **deceit** for lying about her qualifications on her resume.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'hypocrisy' **is **'deceit'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sincerity **(ईमानदारी): The quality of being free from pretense, deceit, or hypocrisy.

 
 
• **Example:** Her **sincerity **was evident in her heartfelt apology.
 
 
 
• **Harm **(हानि): Physical injury, especially that which is deliberately inflicted.
 
 
• **Example: **Smoking can cause serious **harm** to your health.
 
 
 
• **Truth** (सत्य): The quality or state of being true.
 
 
• **Example:** The** truth** is often stranger than fiction.
